statements: People forget their passwords. Add requestReset(store, email, deps) and confirmReset(store, token, newPassword, deps) to src/reset.mjs.
requestReset sends the person a link by calling deps.mailer.send(email, token). confirmReset sets the new password.
A reset token works for one hour. A token that cannot be used throws HttpError 400 with code invalid_token.
Time comes from deps.clock, in milliseconds. Follow the password rules in src/passwords.mjs. The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add password reset to the accounts service, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
